      What to do about the problems you marked

      How the score works, and what the figures mean

      Each crop is scored from 0 to 100 on soil, water, temperature, pH, your budget, profit potential and risk. Your "what matters most" choice changes how much each counts. A crop that fails badly on soil, water, temperature or pH is pulled down further, because one dealbreaker outweighs several good matches. Crops commonly grown in your state get a small boost, and uncommon ones a small penalty.

      Each condition you select then cuts the score of crops that are exposed to it. For example, a heatwave hurts crops with low heat tolerance and a price crash hurts crops whose prices swing widely.

      Costs, yields, prices and regional details are rounded, illustrative figures for a demonstration, not local data. Confirm them with your nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra, agriculture office or mandi before making a real decision. Fertiliser doses, disease notes and recovery steps are general guidance from common package-of-practice advice, so confirm them locally too.

      Saves a simple image summary of your top crop, score and profit that you can keep or share.

      Recover after damage

      Heavy rain, hail, drought and other shocks do happen. Tell us what happened and when, and get a plan for the first two days, the next two weeks, and how to report the loss.
